title: FIPS operational risk: KEY_IMPORT/KEY_GENERATE silent -ENOENT in FIPS mode
description: ioctl_key_import (fd.c:1495-1497) and ioctl_key_generate (fd.c:1572-1574) return -ENOENT with no log message when a FIPS provider is loaded and the requested algo is only served by a non-FIPS provider (e.g. KEY_GENERATE for 'rsa' when only kcapi has it). ioctl_init was fixed (WOLFKM-dfn.18) to emit pr_info_ratelimited naming the algo and FIPS mode, but the fix was not applied to the two key-management paths. A support engineer calling KEY_GENERATE or KEY_IMPORT for an algo that FIPS enforcement has hidden gets a silent -ENOENT with nothing in dmesg to distinguish 'algo not registered' from 'algo exists but is blocked by FIPS'. At audit time, this appears as an unexplained asymmetric-key operation failure with no operational log trail.
